products.name: The Great British Bird Box
products.tagline: Our everyday classic. One box, three species, no fuss.
products.story: The box we have made longest and changed least. Cut, jointed and drilled by hand in Kent from untreated cedar, then left bare so it silvers naturally and never leaches a preservative near a nest. A 32mm hole is the generalist choice — tits take it most years, sparrows some years.
features: Untreated FSC cedar — nothing chemical near the brood
Hinged front panel for autumn cleaning
Stainless steel fixings and hanging plate

products.name: The Songbird Sanctuary
products.tagline: Open-fronted, hedge-hidden nesting for robins and wrens.
products.story: Robins will not use a small round hole. They want a wide, low, half-open front tucked into ivy or a thick hedge, and a deep floor so the nestlings cannot tumble out. Built from reclaimed pine, so no new timber is felled for it.
features: Wide open front with a 100mm deep sill

products.name: The Sparrow Tenement
products.tagline: Three chambers, because house sparrows nest as neighbours.
products.story: House sparrows are colonial birds. A single box often sits empty for years; a terrace of three usually fills inside a season. Sized to the RSPB sparrow-terrace specification and braced for high eaves mounting.
features: Solid dividers so broods stay separate

products.name: The Swift Box
products.tagline: Flush eaves cavity for the bird that needs us most.
products.story: Swift numbers have more than halved as old roofs are sealed and soffits replaced. Woodcrete is breathable, frost-proof and good for twenty-five years, so a box fitted under the eaves this spring will outlast the roof repair that displaced them.
features: Nest concave moulded into the floor

products.name: The Murmuration Mansion
products.tagline: A deep, starling-sized box with a 45mm door.
products.story: Starlings are red-listed in the UK and need a bigger cavity than a tit box gives — 45mm hole, deep floor, and height on the wall. Solid oak, because starlings and woodpeckers will work at an entrance until it gives.
features: Deep 40cm body for a large brood
Mount 3m+ on a wall or mature trunk

products.name: The DIY Bird Box Kit
products.tagline: Six pre-cut cedar panels, screws, and an afternoon with the kids.
products.dims: Builds to H 28 × W 15 × D 16 cm
products.story: Every panel cut, sanded and pre-drilled in the workshop, so all that is left is a screwdriver and twenty minutes. We send these out by the crate to schools and scout groups — ask us about classroom quantities.
features: Screws, hanging plate and Allen key included
Bulk pricing for schools and groups

products.name: The Tawny Owl Plaza
products.tagline: Chimney-style tawny box for a mature garden or woodland edge.
products.story: Tawnies want a deep vertical chimney angled up a trunk, not a wall box. The larch is charred shou-sugi-ban style, which resists rot and insects without a drop of preservative, and weathers to a soft graphite.
features: Deep chimney form, angled mounting cleats
Drainage and a wood-chip nest base
Strap fixings, no nails into the tree

products.name: The Owl Field Cabin
products.tagline: Pole-mounted barn owl box for open farmland.
products.story: For fields with no barn left standing. Twenty-five millimetre marine ply on a braced frame, dark-oiled, sized to Barn Owl Trust internal volume and rated for two decades at the top of an exposed pole.
features: Barn Owl Trust compliant internal volume

products.name: The Barn Owl Homestead
products.tagline: Our largest box, for gable ends and open barns.
products.story: Built to sit inside a barn or on a gable, with a landing shelf outside the entrance and a full-width hatch. Made to order in the workshop — allow three weeks, and tell us your mounting height so we set the shelf correctly.
features: External landing shelf and internal ledge
Three week build, mounting advice included

products.name: The Bat Shack
products.story: Bats need a narrow crevice and a rough surface to climb, not a hole. Every internal face is left saw-toothed and the joints are sealed so the roost stays draught-free — mount three or more at different aspects and let them choose.
features: Fit 4m+ up with a clear flight path below

products.name: The Hedgehog House
products.tagline: Twin-chamber hibernaculum with a predator tunnel.
products.story: A long entrance tunnel a badger or a cat cannot reach down, opening into a sleeping chamber packed with dry leaves. Ten percent of every hedgehog house we sell goes to our local rescue, who take in around four hundred animals a winter.
features: Twin chamber with a felted, liftable roof
Raised floor on feet to stay dry
10% of the price donated to hedgehog rescue

products.name: The Dormouse Box
products.tagline: Rear-entrance woodland box for hazel dormice.
products.story: Entrance at the back, against the branch, exactly how a dormouse wants to arrive. Supplied flat-backed with a wire tie so it sits tight to a hazel stem in coppice or scrub.
features: Flat back and wire tie for hazel stems
Sold in tens for woodland schemes
